description.p: Riteed is an early beta GNOME text editor for editing local text, code, config, and markdown files with encoding-aware open and save behavior.
Riteed er en tidlig GNOME-teksteditor i beta til redigering af lokale tekst-, kode-, konfigurations- og markdownfiler med kodningsbevidst åbne- og gemmeadfærd.

It provides tabs, a unified Find bar with Document and Project scope, document statistics, printing, syntax highlighting, native Markdown preview, optional line numbers and minimap, folder navigation, split diffs, lightweight local Git source control, format controls for text encoding and line endings, curated editor palettes, and conservative reload prompts when files change on disk.

Den tilbyder faner, en samlet søgelinje med dokument- og projektområde, dokumentstatistik, udskrivning, syntaksfremhævning, native Markdown-forhåndsvisning, valgfrie linjenumre og minimap, mappenavigation, split-diffs, let lokal Git-kildekontrol, formatkontroller til tekstkodning og linjeafslutninger, kuraterede editorpaletter og konservative genindlæsningsprompter, når filer ændres på disken.
Autosave is available for already-saved writable files, while read-only and externally changed files stay guarded by explicit user choices.
Automatisk gemning er tilgængelig for allerede gemte skrivbare filer, mens skrivebeskyttede og eksternt ændrede filer fortsat beskyttes af eksplicitte brugervalg.

description.p: Adds local Flatpak build guardrails, print preview, V15 large-file viewer handling, document format controls, and expanded preferences organization.
Fixes native CI GTK smoke diagnostics, large-file routing and viewer edge cases, minimap scrolling, printing, async loading, and release/dependency validation follow-ups.
Adds hardened release, stress, and dependency policy gates, including live ruleset governance, exact-commit publish preflight, rollback safeguards, and coordinated GTK-stack dependency validation.
Restores Source Control minimap diff bands and fixes the scheduled Markdown stress crash, async open/save races, Source Control cap handling, and release-note gettext extraction.

Fixes Markdown preview zoom, copy, and find behavior so the native preview follows editor zoom, keeps its scroll position while copying or navigating matches, and searches rendered Markdown text without exposing replace controls.
Updates app dependencies, beta screenshots, and Dependabot rules while preserving the reviewed GTK binding versions.
Adds the pre-Flathub GitHub Pages beta Flatpak remote, GitHub security hygiene, Dependabot configuration, contribution templates, and CodeQL triage follow-up notes.
Fixes a scheduled Markdown fuzz crash by normalizing ASCII control characters before Markdown preview parsing.

Adds a complete Danish locale, an app language preference for System, English, or Danish, and the first stress-test infrastructure for boundary, parser, fuzz, Flatpak Git, ASan, and Valgrind coverage.
Fixes a fuzz-discovered Compare crash with lone carriage-return line endings by aligning Riteed's row model with the diff engine's line tokenization.
Adds native Markdown preview polish, staged and unstaged multi-file review tabs, and a V15 roadmap for split Markdown edit/preview.
Fixes Source Control so ordinary untracked folders expand to changed file paths while nested Git repositories remain visible as guarded directory entries.
Compacts Source Control rows, moves active-file Git actions into the header bar, and unifies document and project search in the Find bar.
Adds Find in Files, document statistics, and print support while preserving the existing Find and Replace workflow.
First public beta with tabs, syntax highlighting, folder navigation, split diffs, lightweight local Git source control, autosave, and guarded file monitoring.
